licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages by two independent readers, with a judge settling every difference and a sweep for the marks, then a fresh check until clean, and checked against the print again here; every bar of every part adds up. The Italian translation and the stage directions are left out. Playback tempo from the length of two complete recordings (Böhm 1964 4:04, Klemperer 1964 4:49), with the piece's repeats.
